'''1997 Decipher World Championship Joe Alread LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Joe Alread]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/LightJoe.html Joe Alread 1997 WF Light Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991104015845/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/LightJoe.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Alread]]
* '''Event:''' [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth and Cloud City
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Alread LS 1997 Worlds.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
[[Joe Alread]] played this deck at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. It starts at [[Hoth (location)|Hoth]] and runs six [[Cloud Car]]s with six [[Clouds]].<ref name="torch" />
